desc: Looking for a top-quality range that combines elegance, convenience, and powerful performance? Look no further than the Bosch 800 Series Electric Slide-in Range 30'' Stainless Steel.
hl: A Warming Drawer beneath the oven provides extra storage, and keeps your food warm until it's ready to serve.
The slide-in design can replace a freestanding range cutout and slides back against the wall for a sleek built-in look.
With all the cooking you'll do in a Bosch oven, clean-up should be your last worry.
Rapid pre-heat reaches 350F quickly to speed up dinner prep.
A third heating element in the back and a fan circulates heat evenly so you get evenly golden results no matter where you place your pan.
